evidence: Defines consensus rules for Testnet 5 (BIP 95), adjusting proof-of-work difficulty rules and enforcing BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules from block 1.
rationale: Adds Testnet 5 to Bitcoin Core to eliminate earlier testnets' difficulty manipulation and block storms while providing a test network for BIP 54 consensus cleanup rules. As noted in the description, 'it removes the 20-minute minimum-difficulty exception, raises the minimum difficulty, and enforces BIP 54 from block 1', offering durable strategic value to downstream testers and consensus development.
